concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-issuing-authorisation]] — 2023-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Issuing authorization flow: mandatory Adyen checks, optional platform transaction rules and relayed decisions with a 2000 ms response window/fallback, followed by possible scheme-advice precedence.
warnings: Initial approval or refusal may be superseded by later scheme advice; authorization does not establish capture or settlement.
